verdict.rationale: Firstbase provides registered agent service, a compliance dashboard with state deadlines/requirements, and tax filing (extensions, R&D credit determination) plus bookkeeper support for deadlines, which together support timely annual report and franchise tax filing. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm automatic annual report filing across all states or a guarantee of on-time franchise tax payment, and community evidence shows filing fees are still owed by the founder separately. missing for 10: explicit proof of automated annual report filing, franchise tax payment handling, and independent verification of on-time filing track record.
